integration.heading: Twitch integration
integration.description: Connect your Twitch account so Streaming Tree can read and update your channel's metadata. No client secret is ever requested or stored.
integration.clientIdHint: Register an application at the Twitch developer console and paste its Client ID here.
integration.clientIdSourceEnvironment: Set by the STREAMING_TREE_TWITCH_CLIENT_ID environment variable and cannot be changed here.
integration.noSecretNote: Streaming Tree never accepts or stores a Twitch client secret - only the public Client ID.
integration.lockedNote: The Client ID cannot be changed while a Twitch account is connected. Disconnect every Twitch account first.

connect.notConfiguredNote: Configure a Twitch Client ID above before connecting an account.

deviceFlow.title: Connect your Twitch account
deviceFlow.description: Open the link below on any device, sign in to Twitch, and enter the code shown here.
deviceFlow.verificationNote: Go to {{uri}} and enter the code above.

state.waiting_for_user: Waiting for you to authorize on Twitch…
state.polling: Waiting for you to authorize on Twitch…
state.expired: This code expired before it was used.
state.error: The authorization attempt could not be completed.

deviceFlow.successNote: Your Twitch account is now connected.

account.heading: Connected Twitch accounts
account.reconnectRequiredNote: Twitch could not confirm this account's access. Reconnect to keep using it.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {{login}}?
disconnectDialog.message: Streaming Tree will revoke this account's access on Twitch where possible and remove it locally. Any destination linked to it will need to be relinked.

link.heading: Connected Twitch account
link.description: Linking a Twitch account lets you read and publish this destination's metadata. It is separate from the destination's stream key.
link.notLinked: No Twitch account linked to this destination.
link.replaceNote: Linking a different account replaces the current link.
link.reconnectRequiredNote: This account needs to be reconnected before it can be used.
link.missingScopeNote: This account is missing a required permission; reconnect it.
link.noAccountsAvailable: No Twitch accounts are connected yet. Connect one in Settings first.
link.notImplementedNote: Account linking is not implemented yet for this provider.

category.searchPlaceholder: Search for a game or category…
category.linkAccountNote: Link a Twitch account to search for a category.
category.staleNote: This category has no matching Twitch ID and cannot be published until you select it again.

publish.heading: Publish to Twitch
publish.description: Sends your saved metadata to Twitch. This is separate from saving locally.
publish.unsavedNote: Save your local changes before publishing to Twitch.
publish.skippedFields: Not published to Twitch (no equivalent field): {{fields}}

confirmDialog.title: Publish to Twitch?
confirmDialog.message: This sends the changed fields shown below to Twitch right now.

blockers.accountNotLinked: Link a Twitch account to this destination first.
blockers.accountReconnectRequired: The linked Twitch account needs to be reconnected.
blockers.missingRequiredScope: The linked account is missing a required permission.
blockers.categoryNotSelected: Select a category from the search results before publishing.
blockers.rateLimited: Twitch's rate limit was reached; try again shortly.
